note: Tables of real measurements for testing the route outside invented and textbook-generated data. Pinned by source commit and SHA-256. The split was fixed by table name on 2026-11-24 before any row of a held-back table was read (headers and the sources' README files only; one exception is noted on its table). Development tables are copied under benchmarks/real_data/development/ (MIT sources). Held-back tables are never copied into this repository: they are fetched from the pinned commit at the time of a preregistered run.

source.citation: Cornelio et al., Combining data and theory for derivable scientific discovery with AI-Descartes, Nat. Commun. 14, 1777 (2023)

tables.what: Cosmic chronometers: expansion rate against redshift, with each measurement's stated error. The standard model's form is known but disputed forms fit as well: the check is prediction on rows left out.
